episodes.planGoal: 30 Agentic Tools — 5 Stages + Blueprint
episodes.summary: The plugin registers exactly 30 tools all with agentic_ prefix. Stage I Foundation (5): agentic_plan, agentic_execute, agentic_reflect, agentic_verify, agentic_status. episodes.planGoal: Core Planning System — 13 Templates + LLM Fallback + Macro/Phases
episodes.summary: The Planner class in src/core/planner.ts (776 lines) decomposes goals into subtasks. It has 13 DecompositionRule templates: add/create, fix/bug, refactor, test, deploy, migrate, doc, perf, security, docker, ci/cd, research, and generic create. Template selection uses scoring: pattern match (2pt) + keyword match (1pt) + keyword density (0.5pt/kw) + domain bonus (1pt). Falls back to decomposeWithLLM() for arbitrary goals. Also supports hierarchical Macro/Micro phase planning via decomposeMacro() w

episodes.planGoal: LLM Engine — OpenCode SDK Integration with Semantic Cache + Model Resolution

Features: exact-match cache (30s TTL, 1000 entries), Gap #7 semantic cache (TF-IDF + cosine similarity, threshold 0.7), multi-provider auto-fallback chain, cost-aware auto-switch, model resolution by tool→category→explicit override. Method call() is the main entry: resolves model, checks semantic cache, then exact-match cache, calls callOpenCode() via SDK sess

episodes.summary: The agents/ layer has 7 files. Coordinator (src/agents/coordinator.ts) handles task delegation to specialist roles (architect, developer, qa, coordinator, pm), auto-suggests role via LLM→keyword fallback, maintains shared memory with async mutex, and supports 6 inter-agent message types. episodes.planGoal: Memory System — Episodic Store, Skill Store, RAG, Vector Store, Session Store
episodes.summary: The memory/ layer has 13 files providing comprehensive cross-session persistence. EpisodicStore (episodic-store.ts) records task episodes with TF-IDF search, project-scoped isolation, schema versioning, and decay/forgetting. episodes.planGoal: Budget Tracker — Circuit Breaker with Token/Step/Time/Cost Limits
episodes.summary: The BudgetTracker class in src/core/budget-tracker.ts (428 lines) implements a resource circuit breaker pattern (PDP/PEP) with 4 metrics: tokens (input+output+cache+reasoning), steps (subtask count), time (wall-clock minus approval pauses), cost (derived from token × model prices). episodes.planGoal: Drift Layer — Hallucination Guard, Checkpoints, Dependency Tracking, Context Compression
episodes.summary: The drift/ layer has 5 files for error detection and recovery. HallucinationGuard (hallucination-guard.ts) verifies 4 claim types: file_exists, function_exists, import_valid, api_signature. Uses path traversal protection (resolveSafe) and multi-language function detection (TS/JS, Python, Go, Rust). CheckpointSystem (checkpoints.ts) provides 3 risk types: WARNING (informational), REVIEW (request review), BLOCK (halt execution). Detects file deletion, mass changes, API changes, config/secret expos

episodes.planGoal: Model Registry — Per-Model Reliability, Quarantine, Task-Type Scoring
episodes.summary: The ModelRegistry class in src/core/model-registry.ts (475 lines) tracks per-model reliability statistics. Each recordCall() updates total/success/failed counters, running avg latency, cost tracking, and per-task-type breakdowns. Auto-quarantines after 5 consecutive failures (quarantineUntil = now + 30min). Auto-releases after 3 consecutive successes with min 5 calls and hallucination < 0.2. Scoring: reliability = max(0, successRate - hallucinationRate * 2). Status thresholds: healthy vs degrade

episodes.planGoal: Domain System — 6 Built-In Domain Packs with Verifiers and Error Matchers
episodes.summary: The DomainRegistry (domain-registry.ts) manages domain-specific behavior. Each DomainPack contains: detect() function (score 0-1), verifier strategies, error matchers, decomposition rules, file extensions, tools, skills, roles, and formal contracts. 6 built-in domains: generic (fallback — semantic-only verification), code (general SE — TS/JS/Python/Rust/Go language detection), security (OWASP vulnerability scanning), devops (Docker/K8s/Terraform file verification), data-science (ML/DS — PyTorch/

episodes.planGoal: Event System — Pub/Sub EventBus with 9 Namespaces and Live Evaluation
episodes.summary: The EventBus (event-bus.ts) provides pub/sub event system with 9 namespaces: step.*, plan.*, pipeline.*, budget.*, guard.*, task.*, llm.*, file.*, memory.*. Methods: on(type, handler) for specific events, onAny(handler) for wildcard, emit(event) to dispatch. The event-taxonomy.ts defines typed event schemas. Key subscribers in index.ts: LiveEvaluator tracks step outcomes for real-time 5-dimension scoring (taskSuccess 40%, errorRecovery 20%, contextStability 15%, multiAgent 15%, skillReuse 10%).

episodes.planGoal: Prompt System — Knowledge-First Architecture with Auto-Injected RAG Context
episodes.summary: The prompt system implements Knowledge-First Architecture (2026). PromptTemplate (prompt-template.ts, 252 lines) builds XML-structured prompts: <identity> (who the agent is), <knowledge-context> (external knowledge from RAG/web/arXiv, framed as REFERENCE DATA per OWASP), <instructions> (what to do with tools and workflow), <guardrails> (constraints and anti-hallucination rules). KnowledgeEntry interface: source URL, confidence 0-1, content, category. Knowledge is auto-injected into every LLM cal

episodes.planGoal: Self-Evolution System — Skill Patching, Role Suggestion, Prompt Improvement
episodes.summary: The evolution/ layer has 2 files. SelfEvolver (self-evolver.ts) analyzes skills with < 80% success rate and generates patches (add_rollback, add_step, add_verify, add_guard, tighten_i_o, add_fallback). Also suggests new agent roles from failure patterns and generates prompt patches mapped from error categories to role-specific instructions. ContinuousEvolution (continuous-evolution.ts) monitors rolling 30-step window for degrading/improving/stable performance. Features Gap #12 predictive degrada

episodes.planGoal: Observability — Dashboard + Trace Logger + Structured Logger
episodes.summary: The observability/ layer has 3 files. Dashboard (dashboard.ts) provides timeline visualization, 4 anomaly types (timeout >30s, retry_storm 3+ failures, loop same in 5 steps, silent_failure), latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), peak concurrency (interval-based overlap detection), and model reliability statistics. TraceLogger (trace-logger.ts) writes JSONL trace files with buffering (10 entries), 5-second auto-flush, dedup guard (prevents consecutive identical entries), and 7-day retention pruning.

episodes.planGoal: Understand opencode-agentic-engine architecture
episodes.summary: opencode-agentic-engine is an OpenCode plugin implementing agentic software engineering. It has 79 TypeScript source files across 6 layers: core/ (engine: planning, execution, verification, LLM, git, budget), agents/ (multi-agent coordination + A2A protocol), drift/ (error detection, hallucination guard), memory/ (episodic store, skill store, vector store, RAG), evaluation/ (live evaluator), observability/ (trace logger, dashboard). The entry point is src/index.ts which registers 30 tools and 6 hooks.

episodes.planGoal: What are the 30 agentic tools?
episodes.summary: Stage I Foundation (5): agentic_plan, agentic_execute, agentic_reflect, agentic_verify, agentic_status. Stage II Intelligence (8): agentic_nav, agentic_context, agentic_snapshot, agentic_pr, agentic_score, agentic_model, agentic_model_reset, agentic_budget. Stage III Orchestration (9): agentic_delegate, agentic_pipeline, agentic_message, agentic_parallel, agentic_skill, agentic_episodes, agentic_dashboard, agentic_guard, agentic_finetune. Stage IV Evolution (1): agentic_evolve. Stage V Autonomous (1): agentic_auto. Blueprint (6): agentic_debate, agentic_router, agentic_clean, agentic_rag, agentic_mcp, agentic_a2a. All tools use the agentic_ prefix.

episodes.planGoal: Recommended workflow: research → plan → implement → verify
episodes.summary: Phase 1 (Research): Use agentic_nav to scan codebase, agentic_skill find to find reusable skills, agentic_episodes search to learn from past sessions. Phase 2 (Plan): agentic_plan to decompose the goal into ordered subtasks with dependencies. Phase 3 (Implement): agentic_execute for each step, agentic_delegate for complex sub-tasks, agentic_parallel for concurrent independent steps. Phase 4 (Verify): agentic_verify for deep multi-dimensional checks (compile, lint, test, security, performance, architecture, deps). tfidfDocs.title: Recommended workflow: research → plan → implement → verify
tfidfDocs.content:
Phase 1 (Research): Use agentic_nav to scan codebase, agentic_skill find to find reusable skills, agentic_episodes search to learn from past sessions. Phase 2 (Plan): agentic_plan to decompose the goal into ordered subtasks with dependencies. Phase 3 (Implement): agentic_execute for each step, agentic_delegate for complex sub-tasks, agentic_parallel for concurrent independent steps. Phase 4 (Verify): agentic_verify for deep multi-dimensional checks (compile, lint, test, security, performance, architecture, deps). If a step fails, use agentic_reflect to diagnose error category and propagation.
